title: Drunk Mom Acts Like A Maniac After Getting Kicked Out Of A Bar
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 15, 2023. Officers were called to a bar in reference to a highly intoxicated woman who was causing a scene & being rude and belligerent to staff. When officers approached the woman she was crying and said she was just wanted to go home. After speaking more with the bar staff, they decided to ban her from the bar, after officers told the woman the circumstances, she kept trying to invoke her rights and started to become rude to the officers. After she left the scene, officers then found her in a bush where she had been crying. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
